RIFTSHIFT OPERATIONS

Configure runs, inspect discoveries, review achievements, select cosmetics, read field logs, and launch seeded challenges.

DIFFICULTY PROTOCOL

Higher protocols change enemy pressure and rewards rather than only adding health.

STARTING ARSENAL

Select Standard, Alternate, or Experimental starting weapon behavior.

RUN MUTATORS

Stack optional rules. These are intentionally chaotic and remain separate from permanent progression.

SEEDED / CHALLENGE RUNS

Daily seed and special rule sets. Daily uses the calendar date for its map and current-version encounter rolls.

COSMETIC SHELL

Cosmetics never change combat stats.
